meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 安装 OneCLI 并初始化 Agent Vault，将 .env 中的凭据迁移到保险库中，之后凭据由 OneCLI 管理，代理不再直接接触原始密钥。
howto.when: 在运行 /update-nanoclaw 后 OneCLI 作为破坏性变更引入时，或首次设置 OneCLI 时触发。

say.text: 帮我初始化 OneCLI 并迁移 .env 中的凭据。
say.note: 开始执行安装和迁移流程。

say.text: 检查 OneCLI 是否已配置好，如果没有则重新配置。
say.note: 会先检查状态，再决定是否重新安装。

say.text: 把 OpenAI API 密钥也迁移到 OneCLI 保险库。
say.note: 会扫描 .env 并询问是否迁移其他容器凭据。

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI and initializes the Agent Vault, migrating existing .env credentials into the vault. After setup, credentials are managed by OneCLI and agents never see raw keys.
howto.when_en: Triggered after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI and migrate credentials from .env.
say_en.note: Starts the installation and migration process.

say_en.text: Check if OneCLI is configured; if not, reconfigure it.
say_en.note: Checks status first, then decides whether to reinstall.

say_en.text: Migrate the OpenAI API key to the OneCLI vault too.
say_en.note: Scans .env and asks about migrating other container credentials.
